title: Camp Harlam

services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: Nestled in the beautiful Poconos and just a two hour drive from both New York City and Philadelphia, Camp Harlam is the perfect setting for an event, conference, or retreat! We have a library building and meeting center, lounge areas, an indoor gym, a large dining area, a variety of comfortable sleeping accommodations, and more, not to mention some truly stunning outdoor space. Like what you see and want to learn more? Fill out our inquiry form and we’ll be in touch! We are committed to ensuring that no child is denied a Jewish summer experience at URJ Camp Harlam.
